line_items.work_text: Assam Public Works Roads Department (APWRD), Water Resources Department and Irrigation Department to apprise the Chairperson SEC regarding progress of SEC approved projects under SDRF which are yet to be completed in e-file within two days.

Module one of the proposal of IIT Guwahati for Capacity Building amounting to Rs 6,33,50,000/- to be implemented for training program using existing facilities within the campus of IITG covering the cost of food & lodging in IITG, local transportation within IITG, course material, use of computational facility, laboratory, and field visit etc. for the participants.
DPR for wetland projects 'Restoration and Rejuvenation of 16 wetlands of Assam to enhance water retention capacity and mitigate risk of flooding and erosion'.

narrative: The State Executive Committee confirmed the minutes of the 51st meeting and discussed the Action Taken Report on the decisions of the 51st SEC meeting.
